programs.title: Home Town
programs.sub_title: There's Just Something About A Porch
programs.desc: A couple is looking for a historic home in the country with a porch and plenty of green space. Ben and Erin transform their new home into a classic, dogtrot-style house full of historic charm and Southern touches.

programs.title: Good Bones
programs.desc: Mina and Karen are back in Old Southside where they've purchased a hoarder house filled with garbage and hiding fire damage. As demo gets underway, they uncover a slew of other issues as they turn this trash-filled home into an updated Victorian beauty.

programs.title: The Nate And Jeremiah Home Project
programs.desc: Nate and Jeremiah help a couple begin their next chapter together as they update their first home with a rich design palette.

programs.title: Getaway
programs.desc: This week on Getaway, showcasing how to do Bora Bora on a budget, cruising around Turkey plus going back to the time of the dinosaurs in outback Queensland.

programs.title: Postcards
programs.desc: Kris checks out the businesses along the main street of Barwon Heads. Madeline is in Highton, trying her hand at woodworking. Lauren samples the newest pizzeria in Carlton. And Shane finds a slice of Santorini in Oakleigh.

programs.title: Flip Or Flop
programs.desc: Tarek and Christina flip a house in Fullerton, California, right across the street from Tarek's first flip. Before renovating, they have to deal with crumbling concrete and figure out the market for the house.
